Best-structured of the four external-paper KBs in this cohort. Source PDF also on disk. Path consolidation pending.

L2_data_source_availability.detail: Inputs/ST2/Inputs/ExternalSources/Turkey2022/ has 9 source files: turkstat_statistical_indicators_1923_2011.pdf, turkstat_yearbook_2012.pdf, sbb_kkbg_butce_turleri_gsyh_oran.xlsx, sbb_konsolide_butce_gelir_harcama.xlsx, fred_turkey_*.csv (4 files), oecd_turkey_tax_gdp_2000_2023.csv, worldbank_turkey_fiscal_1980_2019.csv, worldbank_turkey_structural_1980_2019.csv, plus muhasebat/ subdir. Pre-parsed turkstat_compensation_labor_share_1980_2006.csv exists at Inputs/ST2/Technical/NickyData/data/raw-data/parsed/.
gaps: ES1601 labor-share data ends 2006 — TurkStat Statistical Indicators 1923-2011 does not publish income-approach GDP tables for 2007+. Years 2007-2019 are NaN per project's no-synthetic-data policy.

ES1602 NSW reconstruction depends on Turkish Ministry of Treasury / SGK / Revenue Administration data not yet ingested for 2007-2019. Currently achieves -0.0098 vs paper target -0.0113 (residual 0.0015) with 27 real years + 13 NaN years.
registry source_file=null for both ES1601 and ES1602 — data sources are documented in research JSONs but not pinned in registry.

Paper's full NSW algebra is transcribed.

L5_validation_refs.detail: Strong validation targets: ES1601 mean=0.397, std=0.032; ES1602 mean=-0.0113 with universal-negativity invariant n_negative=40 (all 40 years negative per paper Section 5.1). Research JSONs document period breakdowns (1980-89 avg -1.0%, 1990-2001 -0.8%, 2002-08 -1.0%, 2009-13 -0.9%, 2014-19 -1.8%) and acceptance range [-0.008, -0.015] for V-layer.
gaps: n_negative=40 is a structural invariant but ES1602 only has 27 real observations (1980-2006) — V03 must condition the invariant check on 1980-2006 only, not assume all 40 years are reproducible.

L6_classification_accuracy.detail: Both content_type=time_series correct. ES1601 (labor share) is a direct TurkStat digitization — no proxy. ES1602 (NSW/GDP) follows the paper's published B=E1+E2*ls, T=T1+T2*ls formula with ls=ES1601 — composite construction. Both correctly carry units=share (with subseries-level units=ratio for ES1602 numerator).
gaps: TurkStat Table 20.37 uses GDP as labor-share denominator; KT 2022 uses NDP — known systematic discrepancy. Should be flagged in registry as 'concept_match: partial' with proxy_justification documenting the GDP-for-NDP substitution (the only available official data) per the no-proxies rule's documentation requirement.

recommendations: PROCEED to Stage 3 INGESTION. Chapter score 85.8 clears the gate.
